payload.action: Review Loop iteration 6 finding detected: FIND-R1-006-01
symptoms: The root chown init container was removed with no replacement: on Linux hosts whose uid is not 1000 (for example uid 1001 on CI runners), the uid-1000 container cannot write the bind-mounted worktree or git directory, so every Stage 4 pass fails, with no preflight and no documentation.
